svg.title: Sheet 2 of 6, detail A, AI systems, with an illustrated depth gauge of nine levels, two of them outside MMDA's gauge, that reads a sample flood photo at knee level, then answers can't tell for a photo with no car wheel or adult clear enough to read: Lusot, flood depth from a street photo, Metro Manila. 0 of 15 flood-free street photos reported as flooded; 1 of 6 sealed test photos given a reading, scored once on November 3, 2026, and that reading was deeper than its label; small samples, results the project calls indicative. 5,900+ automated tests in CI, 5,986 passing on November 10, 2026. Sole developer; Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon; Meta's SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark models; October to November 2026. The live system is shut down, and the demo replays saved real samples.
svg.text: Flood depth from a street photo, Metro Manila
